genericProblem: A recovery screen can appear complete while its entry authority, account scope, brand readback, and public owner protocol do not exist for the claimed user task.
finiteDenominator: platform-admin unauthenticated login and public recovery screens
operations-admin group-workspace-branded unauthenticated login and public recovery screens
public reset initiation, OTP, verification, completion, owner readback, rate-limit, and anti-enumeration contracts
authenticated administrator credential reset and authenticated current-password flows as explicit counterexamples
searchQueries: platform and operations unauthenticated login entry

counterexamples.reason: A privileged account-management action may continue to issue or invalidate credentials; it is not a public self-service entry.
A signed-in user proves the existing password and session; it is not a recovery flow.

findings.finding: Current public recovery is resetGenerationKey-bound while Dexter has approved account-plus-mobile-plus-OTP self-service recovery for both admin faces.
Operations public recovery needs approved group-workspace branding/readback and platform public recovery needs its own face and owner protocol; neither may be inferred from browser values.
